elements.label: Figure B.2.3.2: Wages by economy and selected sectors
elements.description:
Three-panel line chart (All, Manufacturing, Professional). Y-axis in each panel: 'Average monthly earnings (2017PPP)', scale 0 to 3,000 with gridlines at 500 intervals. X-axis: years 2010 to 2020 (labelled at 2010, 2015, 2020). Legend series: Malaysia (teal), Thailand (orange), Philippines (grey), Vietnam (yellow), Cambodia (light blue), Indonesia (green), Myanmar (purple).

Panel 'All': Malaysia rises from ~1,130 (2011) to ~1,820 (2018). Thailand rises from ~800 (2011) to ~1,210 (2020). Philippines rises from ~500 to ~750. Vietnam rises from ~350 (2010) to ~840 (2020). Cambodia rises from ~220 (2010) to ~460 (2016). Indonesia ~300 to ~350 (2011-2015). Myanmar ~380 (2016) to ~460 (2019).

Panel 'Manufacturing': Malaysia ~990 (2011) to ~1,500 (2018). Thailand ~670 (2011) to ~1,140 (2020). Philippines ~500 to ~680. Vietnam ~330 (2010) to ~870 (2020). Cambodia ~180 (2010) to ~500 (2016). Indonesia ~350 to ~330 (2011-2015). Myanmar ~430 (2017) to ~480 (2019).

Panel 'Professional': Malaysia ~1,650 (2011) to ~2,830 (2018, last point). Thailand ~1,480 (2011) to ~1,880 (2020). Philippines ~740 (2010) to ~1,300 (2019-2020). Vietnam ~540 (2010) to ~1,200 (2020). Cambodia ~870 (2010) to ~720 (2017). Indonesia ~880 (2013) and ~720 (2015). Myanmar ~340 (2015) to ~700 (2019).

Pattern: Malaysia has the highest earnings in all three panels and most economies trend upward over time, with Vietnam rising steadily from lower levels.

elements.label: Figure 2.15: Evolution of household income from wages, 2020 vs. 2010
elements.description:
Two-panel grouped bar chart comparing 2010 (teal) and 2020 (orange). Note: Annual nominal household wage income. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010 and 2020.

Panel A 'Share of households with wage income, by type of wage job': y-axis 'Share of household (%)', scale 0-80 in steps of 10. Categories (approximate readings, 2010 / 2020): Primary job ~53 / ~65; With contract ~31 / ~41; Agriculture ~5 / ~4; Manufacturing ~32 / ~39; Services ~28 / ~32; Low-skill ~14 / ~14; Medium-skill ~31 / ~42; High-skill ~15 / ~16. Pattern: 2020 share is higher than 2010 for most job types, with Primary job and Medium-skill showing the largest rises, while Agriculture declines slightly.

Panel B 'Average household wage income, by type of wage job': y-axis 'Annual income (VND, millions)', scale 0-200 in steps of 50. Categories (approximate readings, 2010 / 2020): Primary job ~44 / ~134; With contract ~53 / ~145; Agriculture ~20 / ~56; Manufacturing ~32 / ~115; Services ~44 / ~119; Low-skill ~21 / ~66; Medium-skill ~33 / ~112; High-skill ~65 / ~171. Pattern: incomes roughly tripled for every category between 2010 and 2020, with High-skill jobs earning the most in both years.
